name: GKE - Pod Logs
description: The GKE - Pod Logs - dashboard displays information on the overall health of the pods, along with details on the resources being utilized, errors, warnings, and unusual conditions.
title: GKE - Pod Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName resource severity timestamp type
| json "message.data.resource.type", "message.data.severity", "message.data.timestamp" as type, severity, timestamp
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "involvedObject.kind", "involvedObject.name" as message, kind, pod
| where kind="Pod" or message matches "*pod*"
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| count as events by timestamp, severity, message, pod, cluster
| sort by timestamp

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "reason", "involvedObject.name" as message, reason, pod
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
//| where (message matches "*Container*" or message matches "*container*")
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, reason
| transpose row _timeslice column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes*  jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "reason", "involvedObject.name" as message, reason, pod
| where (message matches "*pod*" or message matches "*Pod*") //and (reason="SuccessfulCreate" or reason="SuccessfulDelete")
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| timeslice 1h
| count as events by _timeslice, reason
| transpose row _timeslice column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName resource type
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "k8s_pod" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "message", "reason", "involvedObject.kind", "involvedObject.name" as message, reason, kind, pod
| where kind="Pod" and (message matches "*Container*" or message matches "*container*")
| count as events by project, cluster, pod, reason
| where pod matches "{{pod}}" and cluster matches "{{cluster}}"
| fields -project,cluster
| transpose row pod column reason
| limit 15
